topic: Class Template Specialization and Inheritance in C++
explanation: In C++, class templates enable the creation of generic classes that can operate with different data types. When combined with inheritance, templates allow for flexible and reusable class hierarchies that can adapt to various types and behaviors. This is particularly useful in the Standard Template Library (STL) and in designing complex, type-safe abstractions. Modern C++ enhances this with features like default template parameters, explicit specializations, and type traits, enabling highly customizable and efficient code.
keywords: Class template specialization, template specialization inheritance, C++ generic class hierarchy
